name: lgamma_near_roots
note: R computes lgamma(x) for x < 10 as log(gamma(x)), whose absolute error (~1e-16) is a large relative error next to the zeros at 1 and 2 (e.g. 2e-10 at 1 + 1e-7). Our series keeps relative accuracy; the TS tests also check these points against the Taylor series of lgamma to full precision.
